plans.description: One entry per test module the run touched, or would touch without `--yes`, sorted by file.

verification.description: What the mutation run `--verify` asked for found, or null when it was not asked for. Every mutant the generated tests in those modules claim to kill is named exactly once, kill sets included.

file.description: The workspace-relative test module, always under `test/`.

imports_added.description: The import lines the module gained, written the way `gleam format` leaves them. A module the file already imports is grown on the line it has rather than imported twice.

tests_skipped.description: The generated tests the module already defined. A suggestion applied twice is written once.

display_id.description: Empty for a mutant the verification run never discovered, which is reported as `missing` and counts as alive.

outcome.description: What became of the mutant under the generated tests.

killed.description: Whether the mutant counts as dead. A timeout does, exactly as the mutation score counts it.

attribution.description: Which of the two runs around the write is owed the kill. `new` means the mutant was alive, or undiscovered, before the generated tests were written and is dead now; `already_killed` means the workspace's own tests were killing it already, so the generated test added nothing; `surviving` means it is alive now, whatever it was before, and the command exits 1 when any entry says so.
